title: Fleet Performance Superintendent
description:
As a
 **Fleet Performance Superintendent** 
 at
 **BSM,** 
 you will be responsible to monitor and provide timely advice for improving the Operational Performance of the fully managed fleet using all available resources for optimising efficiency, reliability and competitiveness.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitors and supports the Company’s drive towards its goals in technical reliability and energy efficient operation, thereby assisting its Clients achieve and maintain their competitive edge.
* Helps develop the Company’s proprietary software platform using existing methodologies as directed by supervisor.
* Monitors and refines modelling methods so as to ensure the software platform always maintains BSM’s lead among competitors.
* Explores software and hardware solutions that can improve the reporting, modelling and analysis quality.
* Ensures the implementation of the performance monitoring system across the fleet.
* Monitors adherence of the ships to predefined reporting frequency and quality standards. Provides guidance and support to the ship’s staff as required.
* Provides support and guidance to the SMC wherever retrofitting of equipment is required and follows up the installation \& implementation process.
* Provides expert advice to the responsible SMC based on the performance analysis results.
* Provides regular reports to Fleet Management.
* Provides suggestions for expanding the performance monitoring portfolio.
* Supports the SMCs with Client specific performance monitoring systems, issuing formal guidance wherever required.
* Supports the COO office team with Analysis Reports related to the fleet’s performance.
* Supports S.M.C. and Clients with the selection of Makers at the newbuilding stage by providing advice based on documented performance records.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* MSc in Marine Engineering and/or Naval Architecture or equivalent
* Preferably 1 year in the technical department of a ship management/owningcompany,shipyard,researchfacilityorClassification society
* Experience with model tests, shop tests and/or sea trials considered a big advantage
* Minimum of five years’ sailing experience


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Very strong analytical skills
* High IT proficiency, preferably with programming knowledge
* Very good project management and organisational skills
* Open to new ideas and keen to challenge convention
* High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem\-solving ability
* Team\-oriented, proactive, and safety\-focused approach


**Why You Should Join Us!**
 We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
   

  

* On\-the\-job training.
* First\-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!

title: Assistant Performance Superintendent
description:
As an
 **Assistant Performance Superintendent** 
 at BSM, you will be responsible for supporting the effective and efficient operation of the Fleet Performance Centre by monitoring vessel performance, improving energy efficiency, and optimizing operational performance across the fleet. You will play a key role in providing data\-driven insights and decision support to fleet teams, helping to achieve operational excellence, enhance fuel efficiency, and support sustainability goals through continuous performance evaluation and improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor and optimize the overall performance and energy efficiency of assigned vessels.
* Collaborate closely with fleet teams to ensure vessel performance KPIs and operational targets are achieved.
* Identify and promote fuel optimization opportunities to improve vessel efficiency and operational performance.
* Ensure adherence to established performance standards and contribute to their continuous enhancement and expansion.
* Conduct technical and performance investigations, supporting the resolution of operational issues through improved modelling, algorithm refinement, and data quality controls.
* Analyze vessel performance data and prepare performance evaluations and reports.
* Support energy efficiency improvement initiatives and enhancements to performance monitoring systems.
* Provide reliable performance data and insights to support effective operational decision\-making.
* Assist in identifying training needs and preparing technical presentations and seminar materials.
* Liaise with vessels to improve reporting quality and ensure accurate and effective performance analysis.
* Support fleet performance optimization initiatives and undertake additional performance\-related tasks as required.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* BS/MS or MEng in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
* Sailing experience onboard as an Engineer.
* Preferably holding a Class 2 Certificate of Competency.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Vessel performance monitoring and analysis.
* Energy efficiency and fuel optimization knowledge.
* Technical investigation and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Data analysis, evaluation, and reporting skills.
* Understanding of performance modelling and data quality management.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills.
* Effective communication and presentation abilities.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Ability to support operational decision\-making through performance insights.
* Continuous improvement orientation and commitment to operational excellence.


**Why You Should Join Us!**
 We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
   

  

* Career development and opportunities within ship management and maritime finance
* Technical and soft skills training
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage
* Annual performance bonus
* Exposure to international clients, vessels and a diverse workforce
* Flexible opportunities for career progression within the Schulte Group family

title: Google Ads Specialist
description:
Job Summary
 
 We are looking for a results\-driven Google Ads Specialist with 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in planning, executing, and optimizing Google Ads campaigns. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Google Search, Display, Performance Max, and Remarketing campaigns, with the ability to generate quality leads and improve ROI through data\-driven strategies.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Plan, create, and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Optimize campaigns to improve CTR, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Set up and manage conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), and Google Ads.
* Monitor campaign performance and make data\-driven adjustments to budgets, bidding strategies, and ad creatives.
* Create compelling ad copy and ad extensions to improve campaign performance.
* Perform A/B testing on ads, landing pages, and campaign strategies.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
* Collaborate with the design, content, and web development teams to improve landing page performance.
* Stay updated with the latest Google Ads features, trends, and industry best practices.



  




 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 * Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
* **1–2 years of strong hands\-on experience in Google Ads campaign management.**
* Strong understanding of Google Search, Display, Performance Max, and Remarketing campaigns.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and conversion tracking.
* Knowledge of keyword research tools and competitor analysis.
* Ability to analyze data and optimize campaigns for lead generation and ROI.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and reporting skills.
* Google Ads Certification is preferred.



  




 Preferred Skills
 * Experience managing campaigns for multiple industries.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and landing page optimization.
* Experience with CRM integration and lead tracking.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads is an added advantage.

title: Clinical Data Management Associate – Fresher Only
description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Clinical Data Management Associate supports the collection, review, cleaning, validation, and management of clinical trial data to ensure it is accurate, complete, consistent, and compliant with applicable clinical research standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Support clinical data management activities for clinical trials.
* Perform data review, validation, and discrepancy identification.
* Assist with EDC (Electronic Data Capture) systems and clinical databases.
* Review eCRFs/CRFs for completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
* Generate and resolve data queries in coordination with clinical sites and study teams.
* Assist with data cleaning, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Support database setup, testing, and data validation activities.
* Perform reconciliation of clinical data with laboratory, safety, and other external data sources.
* Maintain accurate documentation and study\-related records.
* Follow SOPs, GCP, CDISC, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Coding, Pharmacovigilance, and other project teams.
* Support database lock and study close\-out activities.



  





**Eligibility** 




 \* B.Pharm / M.Pharm
 



 \* B.Sc / M.Sc Life Sciences
 



 \* Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology
 



 \* Clinical Research or related disciplines
 



 \* Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience may apply.
